top_signals.title: Bohl: Iran Won’t Succumb to Trump’s Pressure Campaign
top_signals.summary: Iran has promoted a hardline ex-commander as its top security official, shaking up its highest decision-making body on national defense. It comes after Tehran said it was "very close" to a deal with Oman, over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz but say there has been no negotiations with the US. Ryan Bohl, Senior Middle East and North Africa Analyst at RANE spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on the likely scenario in the impasse. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Global Stock Rally Extends, Oil Pares Advance: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Global stocks traded near a record high as Asian shares tracked Wall Street higher after soft US jobs data eased expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike. Oil pared earlier gains as a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remained elusive.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Philippine Central Bank Keeps Rate Hike on Table Despite Weak GDP Growth
top_signals.summary: The Philippine central bank is ready to tighten monetary policy further to guide inflation back to target, Governor Eli Remolona said, while adding that there’s less pressure to do so after last quarter’s surprise economic slowdown.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Adnoc Gas CFO Eyes LNG Export Plant on UAE East Coast
top_signals.summary: Adnoc Gas reported net income for the second quarter of $665 million that beat the average analyst estimate even as the Mideast conflict disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. CFO Peter van Driel spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar about the numbers. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Adnoc Gas Exploring New LNG Export Plant to Avoid Hormuz Strait
top_signals.summary: Adnoc Gas Plc is considering a new gas export facility outside the contested Strait of Hormuz, Abu Dhabi’s latest move to build infrastructure to avoid the critical waterway that has been largely shut during the Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Firestorm Labs builds drones aboard USS Essex without shore resupply
top_signals.summary: Service members aboard the USS Essex were able to 3D-print 12 first-person view drones using a containerized microfactory.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Abel puts a big chunk of Berkshire's cash to work
top_signals.summary: In his second quarter as the new CEO of Berkshire Hathaway, Greg Abel did some serious spending, including $4.5 billion on buybacks.

top_signals.title: Trump-class battleship program will cost $275 billion, CBO report says
top_signals.summary: The Congressional Budget Office estimates the Navy’s new Trump-class battleship program will cost $275 billion, with the first ship costing $23.4 billion.
